integrity: The formal-power-series derivation is self-contained; separate exhaustive and exact-integer coefficient checks accompany it. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The mixed covariance is proved only for uniform ordered full binary trees.
No joint central limit theorem or finite-size sign classification is asserted.
Earlier multivariate tree-enumeration literature could implicitly include an equivalent identity.
title: A nonzero residual cherry–leaf-parity covariance in uniform Catalan trees
